conditions.source: Unmodified pinned upstream regular UTF-8 C/H source subset; excluded members listed in capture manifest
conditions.cache: OS cache uncontrolled, explicit warmups; NOT cold-cache
conditions.timing: Fresh target process each sample; startup/shutdown included, isolated Python helper startup excluded
conditions.comparison: RS count-only versus rg complete count scans. rg per-file output is included in wall-time; -l early-exit is never used
conditions.regex: Matching lines: rg --count, not --count-matches. Only portable ASCII expressions
conditions.terms: rg -wF equivalence checked against capture-time byte-exact RS token reference; no general Unicode-equivalence assumption
conditions.correctness: Full per-file counts outside timings at 1024 MiB/pages 10000/1 MiB envelopes; same-snapshot top16 ranking and independent first16 source snippets
conditions.resources: Isolated target CPU/RSS via perf_benchmark.py. POSIX RSS may include inherited Python pre-exec floor
conditions.build: Separate randomized create samples; 1-3 samples are descriptive, not stable build p95 evidence
conditions.profiles: Each executable searches its own immutable profile index; same current snapshot also read by both binaries for ranking
conditions.coverage: This host/compiler and two explicit pinned source subsets only; no claim of user fixture reproduction or unexecuted platform testing
